m: वर्ध् cl. 10. P. वर्धयति (also वर्धापयति; cf. below), to cut, divide, shear, cut off, Dhātup. xxxii, 111; to fill, ib. (in this sense rather Caus. of √ वृध्).
a: वर्ध् — {c10c} U. (वर्धयति-से, also वर्धापयति) 1 To cut, divide, shear. --2 To fill.

m: 1. वर्धापक m. (prob.) one who performs the ceremony of cutting the umbilical cord, L. (prob.) the presents distributed at this ceremony, L.
2. वर्धापक m. = कञ्चुक, पांसु-चामर, and पूर्ण-पात्र, L.
1. वर्धापन n. (for 2. See col. 2) the act of cutting the umbilical cord, (or) the ceremony in commemoration of that act, Vet.; Pur.
(prob.) = वर्धापक, presents distributed at the ceremony of cutting the umbilical cord, L.
2. वर्धापन n. (for 1. See col. 1; possibly 1. and 2. ought not to be separated) a birthday ceremony, festival on a birthday or any festive occasion, L.
a: वर्धापनं — [वर्धं छेदं करोति, वृध् णिच्-आप् च ततो भावे ल्युट्] 1 Cutting, dividing. --2 Cutting the umbilical cord, or the ceremony connected with this act. --3 A festival on a birth-day. --4 Any festival in general when wishes for prosperity and other congratulatory expressions are offered; cf. पूर्णपात्र.

m: 1. वर्धापनक n. the cutting of the umbilical cord, (or) a ceremony commemorating it, Pañcat.
2. वर्धाप˚नक n. id.
congratulation, congratulatory gift, Campak.
वर्धापन—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
वर्धाप˚निक mfn. congratulatory, auspicious, ib.
वर्धापिका f. (इका) a nurse, HPariś. (cf. prec.)
वर्धाय ind. having congratulated, Hariv. (v.l. and prob. more correct वर्धाप्य).
1. वर्ध m. (for 2. See below) cutting, dividing, W.
वर्ध n. lead, L. (cf. वर्ध्र).
2. वर्ध mfn. (fr. √ वृध्; for 1. वर्ध See above) increasing, augmenting, gladdening (see नन्दि- and मित्र-व्˚)
वर्ध m. the act of increasing, giving increase or prosperity, RV.
increase, augmentation, W.
Clerodendrum Siphonantus, L.
वर्ध &c. See p. 926, col. 1.
a: वर्धः — 1 Cutting, dividing. --2 Increasing, causing increase or prosperity. --3 Increase, augmentation. --र्धं 1 Lead. --2 Red lead.

m: वर्ध—फल m. Pongamia Glabra, L.
वर्धक mfn. cutting, dividing, cutting off, shearing (see माष- and श्मश्रु-व्˚)
वर्धक m. a carpenter, R.
a: वर्धक — a. [वृध्-णिच् ण्वुल्] 1 Increasing. --2 Cutting, dividing. --3 Filling. --कः A carpenter.

k.v: अङ्गारवल्ली बालेयशाकबर्बरवर्धकाः। मञ्जिष्टा विकसा जिङ्गी समङ्गा कालमेषिका॥

m: वर्धकि m. a carpenter, MBh.; R.; Hariv.; VarBṛS. (also ˚किन्).

k.v: तक्षा तु वर्धकिस्त्वष्टा रथकारस्तु काष्ठतट्. ग्रामाधीनो ग्रामतक्षः कौटतक्षोऽनधीनकः॥

m: वर्धकि—हस्त m. a carpenter's measure of 42 inches, L.
वर्ध—माल m. N. of a Brāhman, Buddh.
वर्धमाना (आ), f. a species of Gāyatrī metre, RPrāt.
N. of the town of Bardwān, Vet.
वर्धमानी (ई), f. N. of a Comm. written by Vardhamāna
वर्धमान mfn. increasing, growing, thriving, prosperous, RV. &c. &c.
वर्धमान m. Ricinus Communis (so called from its vigorous growth), Suśr.
वर्धमान m. sweet citron, L. (also f(आ). )
वर्धमान m. a partic. way of joining the hands, Cat.
a partic. attitude in dancing, Saṃgīt.
a kind of riddle or charade, L.
N. of Viṣṇu, L.
of a mountain and district (also of its town, now called Bardwān or Burdwān), VarBṛS.; Pur.
of a Grāma, Rājat.
of various authors and other men, Cat.
of the last of the 24 Arhats or Jinas, Jain.
of the elephant who supports the eastern quarter, L.
(pl.) of a people, MārkP.
वर्धमान m. or n. a kind of mystical figure or diagram, VarBṛS.; Lalit.
वर्धमान m. a dish or platter of a partic. shape (sometimes used as a lid or cover for water-jars &c.), MBh.; Suśr.
a house having no entrance on the south side, VarBṛS.; MatsyaP.
वर्धमान n. = वर्धमानपुर, Kathās.; Pañcat.
a kind of metre, Col.
a: वर्धमान — a. [वृध् --शानच्] Growing, increasing. --नः 1 The castor-oil plant. --2 A kind of riddle. --3 N. of Viṣṇu. --4 N. of a district (said to be the same as the modern Bardvāna). --5 Sweet citron. --नः, --नं 1 A pot or dish of a particular shape, lid. --2 A kind of mystical diagram. --3 A palace or temple built in the form of the above diagram. --4 A house having no door on the south side. --ना N. of a district (the modern Bardvāna). --Comp. --पुरं the city of Bardvāna.

k.v: एरण्ड उरुबूकश्च रुचकश्चित्रकश्च सः। चञ्चुः पञ्चाङ्गुलो मण्डवर्धमानव्यडम्बकाः॥

m: वर्धमान—द्वार n. ‘gate leading to Vardhamāna’, N. of a gate in Hastināpura, MBh.
वर्धमानक m. a dish or saucer of a partic. shape, lid or cover, MBh.
a partic. way of joining the hands, Cat.
N. of a class of persons following a partic. trade, MBh. (Nīlak.)
of a district or of a people, AV.Pariś.
of a serpent-demon, Buddh.
of various men, Mṛcch.; Pañcat.
a: वर्धमानकः — A kind of dish or pot, lid or cover.

k.v: घटः कुटनिपावस्त्री शरावो वर्धमानकः। ऋजीषं पिष्टपचनं कंसोऽस्त्री पानभाजनम्.।

m: वर्धमान—मति m. N. of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.
वर्धमान—मिश्र m. N. of a grammarian, L.
वर्धमान—पूरण n. N. of wk.
वर्धमान—प्रक्रिया f. N. of wk.
वर्धमान—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
वर्धमान—पुरीय mfn. coming from or born in V˚, Kathās.
वर्धमान—पुर n. the town of Bardwān, ib.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
वर्धमान—पुर—द्वार n. the gate leading to the town of Bardwān, MBh.
वर्धमान—स्वामिन् m. N. of a Jina, L.
वर्धमानेश m. N. of a partic. temple or an image, Rājat.
वर्धमानेन्दु m. N. of a Comm. on the Vardhamānī.
वर्धनी (ई), f. a broom, brush, L.
a water-jar of a partic. shape, Pur.; Hcat. (cf. वार्धनि)
वर्धनीय mfn. to be increased or strengthened to be made prosperous or happy, Inscr.; MBh.; Hariv.
वर्धनीय—ता f.
वर्धनीय—त्व n. augmentability, MW.
1. वर्धन n. the act of cutting or cutting off (see नाभि-व्˚)
वर्धन mfn. ifc. after a proper N. prob. = ‘town’ (cf. पुण्ड्र-व्˚, and Old Persian vardana).
2. वर्धन mf(ई)n. increasing, growing, thriving, MBh.
(often ifc.) causing to increase, strengthening, granting prosperity, RV. &c. &c.
(mostly ifc.) animating, gladdening, exhilarating, MBh.; R.; BhP.
वर्धन m. a granter of increase, bestower of prosperity, ib.
a tooth growing over another tooth, Suśr.
(in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
of one of Skanda's attendants, ib.
of a son of Kṛṣṇa and Mitra-vindā, BhP.
वर्धन (अम्), n. the act of increasing, increase, growth, prosperity, success, MBh.; R.
enlarging, magnifying, strengthening, promoting, KātyŚr.; Hit.
a means of strengthening, restorative, comfort, RV.
educating, rearing, Kathās.
वर्धन &c. See p. 926, col. 1.
a: वर्धन — a. [वृध्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युद् वा] 1 Increasing, growing. --2 Causing to increase, enlarging, magnifying. --नः 1 A bestower of prosperity. --2 A tooth growing over another tooth. --3 N. of Śiva. --नी 1 A broom. --2 A bier. --3 A water-jar of a particular shape. --नं 1 Growing, thriving. --2 Growth, increase, prosperity, magnifying, enlargement. --3 Elevation. --4 Exhilaration (of spirits), animation. --5 Educating, rearing. --6 Cutting, dividing; as in नाभिर्वधनं --7 A means of strengthening, restorative. --8 Filling.

k.v: वर्धनं छेदनेऽथ द्वे आनन्दनसभाजने। आप्रच्छन्नमथाम्नायः सम्प्रदायः क्षये क्षिया॥

m: वर्धन—शील mfn. having a tendency to increase or grow, increasing, growing, MW.
वर्धनक mf(इका)n. exhilarating, gladdening (see चक्षुर्-वर्धनिका)
वर्धन—सूरि m. N. of a Jaina preceptor, W.
वर्धन—स्वामिन् m. N. of a partic. temple or image, Rājat.
वर्धनिका f. a small vessel in which sacred water is kept, Buddh.
a: वर्धनिका — A small vessel in which sacred water is kept.

m: वर्धयितृ mfn. one who causes to grow or increase &c.
वर्धयितृ m. (ifc.) an educator, rearer of (f(ई). ), Kathās.
वर्धिन् mfn. augmenting, increasing (ifc., always f(इनी). ), MBh.; R. &c.
वर्धि-पथक m. or n. (?) N. of a district, Inscr.

carved or fashioned (as timber for a building)
fabricated, built, Vāstuv.
filled, full, L.
2. वर्धित mfn. increased, grown, expanded, augmented, strengthened, promoted, gladdened, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वर्धित n. a kind of dish (?), Mn. iii, 224.
a: वर्धित — p. p. 1 Grown, increased. --2 Enlarged, magnified. --3 Cut. --4 Filled, full.

m: वर्धितव्य mfn. to be increased &c.

वर्धिष्णु mfn. increasing, growing, Śiś.
enlarging, expanding, W.

वर्ध्म—रोग m. the above disease, ŚārṅgS.

leather, L.
lead, L.
a: वर्ध्रं — 1 A leather strap or thong. --2 Leather. --3 Lead.
